title: Paddle Duel
summary: Fast paddle-and-ball duel for two players on one keyboard, or you against the computer.
description: Keep the ball in play and get it past your opponent. The ball speeds up with every return, and hitting it near the edge of your paddle sends it off at a sharper angle. First to 7 points wins. Play against a friend on the same keyboard or against a computer opponent with three difficulty levels.
controls: Player 1: W / S. Player 2: ↑ / ↓. Touch: drag on your half of the screen. Gamepads work too. P pauses.

title: Four in a Row
summary: Drop discs and line up four before your opponent does. Pass-and-play or vs computer.
description: Take turns dropping discs into a seven-column grid. The first player to connect four in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins. Play with a friend on one device, or against a computer opponent that looks several moves ahead on its harder setting.
controls: Click or tap a column. Keyboard: ← / → to choose a column, Enter or Space to drop.

title: Light Trails
summary: Up to four players steer trails around the arena. Last one moving wins the round.
description: Every player leaves a solid trail behind them. Turn to avoid walls and trails, and try to box your opponents in. The last player still moving wins the round, and the first to win five rounds takes the match. Up to four people can share one keyboard or use gamepads, and computer players fill any empty seats.
controls: P1: W A S D. P2: arrow keys. P3: I J K L. P4: numpad 8 4 5 6. Swipe on touch screens (player 1). Gamepads take the next free seat. P pauses.

title: Reflex Party
summary: Two to four players, one screen, one button each. Wait for the signal, then be fastest.
description: Each player gets one key, or one corner of a phone or tablet screen. Every round has a rule: wait for GO, react only when the colours match, or only when the number is even. Press at the right moment to score and too early to lose a point. First to five points wins.
controls: P1: Q. P2: P. P3: Z. P4: M. On touch screens each player taps their own corner.

title: Memory Pairs
summary: Flip cards and find matching pairs. Play solo against the clock or take turns with up to four.
description: All cards start face down. Turn over two at a time and keep them if they match. On your own, try to clear the board in as few moves as possible. With two to four players, take turns passing the device around; find a pair and you go again. The player with the most pairs wins.
controls: Click or tap a card. Keyboard: arrow keys to move, Enter or Space to flip.

title: Dots and Boxes
summary: The pencil-and-paper classic for two to four players, or you against the computer.
description: Take turns drawing a line between two neighbouring dots. Complete the fourth side of a box to claim it and take another turn. When every line is drawn, the player with the most boxes wins. Choose a board size and play pass-and-play with up to four people or against the computer.
controls: Click or tap between two dots. Keyboard: Tab moves between lines, Enter draws.

title: Loop Racer
summary: Top-down three-lap races for one or two players against computer cars.
description: Race three laps around a twisting circuit against computer-controlled cars. Stay on the tarmac: the grass slows you down. Two players can race on the same keyboard, and a lap timer tracks your best lap.
controls: P1: W to accelerate, A / D to steer, S to brake. P2: arrow keys. Touch: on-screen buttons. Gamepads work too. P pauses.

title: Brawlhalla
summary: Free-to-play platform fighter where you knock opponents off the stage.
description: A platform fighter in which damage makes opponents easier to launch, and the goal is to knock them off the stage. Matches range from one-on-one to eight-player free-for-alls, with couch play, online matchmaking and cross-play between platforms.
priceNote: Free to play; optional cosmetic purchases.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
controls: Controller or keyboard; touch controls on mobile.

title: Stick Fight: The Game
summary: Chaotic physics brawler for two to four stick figures, locally or online.
description: Stick figures scramble for weapons that drop into physics-driven levels, and the last one standing wins the round. Levels change constantly, so every round plays differently. Supports local play and online lobbies of up to four.

title: Gang Beasts
summary: Floppy physics brawler: grab, climb and throw your friends off the level.
description: Wobbly jelly-like characters wrestle on dangerous stages such as moving lorries and industrial grinders. Grab opponents and throw them into hazards. It is clumsy by design, which makes it a reliable party game for groups.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Street Fighter 6
summary: One-on-one fighting game with an optional simplified control scheme for newcomers.
description: A traditional one-on-one fighter with a large cast, online ranked matches and local versus. A simplified control type lets newer players perform special moves with single buttons, and a single-player story mode teaches the basics.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
controls: Controller or arcade stick recommended; keyboard supported.

title: Tekken 8
summary: Three-dimensional one-on-one fighter built around aggressive attacks.
description: A 3D fighting game in which characters can sidestep around the arena. It includes a story campaign, arcade modes and online ranked play, plus local versus for two players on one screen.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
summary: Nintendo's crossover platform fighter for up to eight players on one Switch.
description: Characters from Nintendo and other series battle on stages drawn from their games, trying to knock each other off screen. Up to eight players can fight on one console, and items and rule settings let you tune matches from casual chaos to serious one-on-ones.
priceNote: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership.

title: TowerFall Ascension
summary: Four-player archery battles in small single-screen arenas.
description: Archers dodge, jump and stomp through compact arenas, and every arrow is precious because you have to pick it back up. It is a local game: up to four players on one screen in versus, or two in the co-op quest mode.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Duck Game
summary: Frantic one-hit duck shootouts for up to four players, local or online.
description: Ducks grab whatever weapon is nearby and try to be the last one standing, with most rounds lasting seconds. Levels are packed with odd weapons and traps. Supports four players locally or online, plus a level editor.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Rivals of Aether
summary: Pixel-art platform fighter with elemental characters and a competitive edge.
description: A platform fighter where each character's moves are built around an element such as fire or water. It supports up to four players locally, online matches and team battles, and has an active competitive scene.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Nidhogg 2
summary: Tug-of-war sword duel: kill your rival and run for the other end of the level.
description: Two players duel with swords, daggers and bows. Winning a clash earns the right to run towards your end of the level, where the Nidhogg waits, while the opponent respawns ahead of you to block the way. Matches are short and tense.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
summary: Kart racing with items, for up to four players on one screen.
description: Race Nintendo characters around loop-the-loops and anti-gravity tracks while throwing shells and bananas. Up to four people can race in split-screen, and assist options such as smart steering make it easy for new players to join in. There is also a battle mode.
priceNote: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
controls: Nintendo Switch controllers; one Joy-Con per player works.

title: Forza Horizon 5
summary: Open-world driving festival set across a huge map of Mexico.
description: Drive hundreds of real cars across deserts, jungles and cities in an open world full of races, stunts and challenges. You can play entirely solo or meet other players online for co-op and competitive events.
accountNote: Needs a Microsoft account (and Steam on the Steam version).
controls: Controller or wheel recommended; keyboard supported.

title: Rocket League
summary: Football with rocket-powered cars. Free to play, with split-screen and online teams.
description: Two teams of rocket-boosting cars try to knock a giant ball into the opposing goal. Matches last five minutes, so it is easy to play one more. Supports split-screen for up to four on one screen and online teams up to four-versus-four.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.
controls: Controller recommended; keyboard and mouse supported.

title: Smash Karts
summary: Browser kart battle game: drive around arenas and blast other players.
description: A multiplayer kart game that runs in the browser. Drive around small arenas, collect weapon boxes and knock out other players to top the scoreboard. You can join a public match instantly or make a private room for friends.
priceNote: Free with ads and optional purchases.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to drive, Space to fire.

title: Phasmophobia
summary: Co-op ghost hunting for up to four: gather evidence and identify the ghost.
description: You and up to three friends investigate haunted locations with EMF readers, spirit boxes and cameras, trying to work out what kind of ghost is there before it hunts you. Voice chat matters: the ghost can hear you. It can be played solo, but it shines with a group.
priceNote: In early access.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
controls: Keyboard and mouse or controller; VR supported on PC.

title: Lethal Company
summary: Four-player co-op horror about scavenging scrap from dangerous abandoned moons.
description: Your crew lands on hostile moons to collect scrap and meet an ever-rising quota. Creatures lurk in the dark, and proximity voice chat means you only hear teammates who are nearby. Tense and often very funny with friends.
priceNote: In early access.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; partial controller support.

title: Dead by Daylight
summary: Asymmetric horror: four survivors try to escape while one player hunts them.
description: One player is the killer and four others are survivors who must repair generators and escape. Survivors cooperate, the killer hunts, and each side plays very differently. Matches are online, with cross-play on most platforms.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's
summary: Survive five night shifts watching cameras while animatronics creep closer.
description: You are a night guard stuck in an office, with only security cameras, two doors and a limited power supply. Watch the animatronics and close the doors at the right moment. Each night is short, which makes it a good quick scare.
accountNote: Needs a Steam, console or app store account.

title: Inscryption
summary: An unsettling card game played in a dark cabin against a mysterious opponent.
description: A deckbuilding roguelike in which you play cards against a figure across a table, escaping the cabin between hands by solving puzzles. It changes shape as it goes, so it is best played knowing as little as possible.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: The Forest
summary: Survival horror after a plane crash: build a shelter and survive the forest's inhabitants.
description: After a plane crash on a wooded peninsula, you gather resources, build a base and explore caves while hostile locals watch you. It works solo, but up to eight players can survive together online.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; partial controller support.

title: Sons Of The Forest
summary: Sequel to The Forest: survive, build and explore an island with up to eight players.
description: Sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, you end up fighting to survive. Build freely with logs, craft gear and explore caves, alone or with up to seven friends online.

title: Devour
summary: Co-op horror for up to four: banish a possessed cult leader before she catches you.
description: A group of cultists must stop their possessed leader by finding and burning ritual items while she hunts them. Rounds are short and frantic, and it is designed around playing with friends online.

title: Content Warning
summary: Film spooky footage with friends and try to go viral. Online co-op for up to four.
description: Your group heads into an old world with a camera to film monsters and strange events, then uploads the footage to earn views. Getting a good shot usually means getting too close. Built for online co-op with friends.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; partial controller support.

title: Buckshot Roulette
summary: A grim game of chance and bluffing with a shotgun, a dealer and a handful of items.
description: Take turns with the dealer deciding who to point a shotgun at, knowing how many live and blank shells are loaded but not their order. Items let you peek, skip or double the risk. Short and tense, with an online mode for two to four players.

title: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
summary: Classic first-person horror: explore a castle with no way to fight back.
description: You wake in a dark Prussian castle with no memory. There are no weapons, so the only options are to hide, run and manage your light and sanity. A landmark of the genre that still holds up.

title: Among Us
summary: Social deduction for 4–15 players: finish tasks, or find the impostors.
description: Crewmates complete tasks around a spaceship while one or more impostors secretly sabotage and eliminate them. When a body is found, everyone meets to discuss and vote someone out. It plays online or over the same local network, with cross-play between PC, consoles and phones.
priceNote: Paid on PC and consoles; free with ads on mobile.
accountNote: Online play needs a free Innersloth account.

title: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
summary: Five party games in one, played with your phones as controllers.
description: The game runs on a TV or computer while everyone joins from their own phone's browser, so there is no need for extra controllers. The pack includes Quiplash 2, Trivia Murder Party and three other games. Most games take three to eight players, and extra people can join as the audience.
accountNote: Needs a store account for the host; players join from a phone browser without one.
controls: Each player uses their own phone or tablet browser.

title: Overcooked! 2
summary: Chaotic co-op cooking: chop, cook and serve orders in absurd kitchens.
description: Up to four chefs have to prepare and serve orders while the kitchen moves, catches fire or splits in half. Communication is everything. Play on one screen or online, co-op or in versus mode.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
controls: Controllers recommended; keyboard supported for two.

title: Ultimate Chicken Horse
summary: Build a platforming level together, then try to finish it while your friends can't.
description: Each round, players place traps and platforms into the level, then race to the goal. You score by finishing when others fail, so every piece is a balance between helping yourself and sabotaging friends. Supports four players locally or online.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: PICO PARK
summary: Cooperative puzzle platformer for 2–8 players where everyone has to work together.
description: Simple-looking levels that can only be solved by coordinating the whole group: stacking on each other, pushing together or pressing switches in sequence. Supports two to eight players locally or online.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
summary: One player defuses a bomb; everyone else reads the manual they can't see.
description: The defuser sees the bomb but not the instructions, and the experts have the bomb manual but cannot see the bomb. You have to describe, listen and decide fast. Needs at least two people in the same room; any number can help read the manual.
controls: Mouse, controller or touch; VR supported.

title: Human: Fall Flat
summary: Wobbly physics puzzle platformer, funnier with up to eight friends.
description: Guide a floppy character through dreamlike levels by grabbing, climbing and swinging with each arm separately. Puzzles often have several solutions. Two can play split-screen on one computer or console, and up to eight online.

title: Heave Ho
summary: Swing across gaps by holding hands with your friends. Local co-op for up to four.
description: Each character is a head with two arms that can grab walls and each other. Make human chains to swing across chasms, then decide whether to help your friends or let go. Local only, for one to four players.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Fall Guys
summary: Free-to-play obstacle-course battle royale with squads of up to four.
description: Dozens of jelly-bean characters race through obstacle courses and mini-games, with players eliminated round by round until one wins the crown. Party up with friends online in squads.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Mario Party Superstars
summary: Board game plus mini-games for four, with classic boards from older Mario Party games.
description: Four players roll dice around a board collecting coins and stars, with a mini-game after every round. Includes boards and mini-games remade from earlier Mario Party games, and supports local and online play.
priceNote: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership.

title: skribbl.io
summary: Free online drawing and guessing game. One player draws, everyone else guesses.
description: Each round one player picks a word and draws it while the others race to guess it in the chat. Join a public room or create a private room for up to 20 friends, with custom words if you like. Runs in any browser.
priceNote: Free with ads.
controls: Mouse or touch to draw; keyboard to guess.

title: Codenames Online
summary: The official browser version of the team word game. Share a room link and play.
description: Two teams race to identify their agents on a grid of words. Each team's spymaster gives one-word clues that link several words, and teammates guess, trying to avoid the assassin. Share the room URL with friends and use your own voice chat.

title: It Takes Two
summary: A two-player-only co-op adventure where every level plays differently.
description: A couple turned into dolls must work together to get home. Each chapter introduces new abilities that only make sense in combination, and the game cannot be played alone. Play split-screen or online; with the Friend's Pass only one player needs to own the game.
priceNote: Friend's Pass: a second player can join online for free.
accountNote: Needs an EA account and a store account.

title: Split Fiction
summary: Two-player co-op adventure jumping between science-fiction and fantasy worlds.
description: Two writers trapped in a simulation of their own stories must cooperate to escape, switching between sci-fi and fantasy settings with new mechanics in every chapter. Two players only, split-screen or online, with a free Friend's Pass for the second player.
priceNote: Friend's Pass: a second player can join online for free.
accountNote: Needs an EA account and a store account.

title: Portal 2
summary: First-person portal puzzles, with a separate two-player co-op campaign.
description: Solve test chambers by placing linked portals on walls and floors. The single-player story is funny and inventive, and a separate co-op campaign for two players has puzzles that need both people's portals.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.

title: Stardew Valley
summary: Relaxing farming life sim, solo or with friends on a shared farm.
description: Inherit an overgrown farm, grow crops, raise animals, fish, mine and get to know the townspeople. Play at your own pace, alone or with friends on a shared farm, including split-screen on one screen.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, controller or touch.

title: Terraria
summary: 2D sandbox of digging, building, crafting and boss fights.
description: Dig into a procedurally generated world, build a base, craft better gear and take on dozens of bosses. There is a lot of game here. Play solo or online with friends; the console versions also offer split-screen.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, controller or touch.

title: Minecraft
summary: Build anything from blocks, survive the night, and explore endless worlds.
description: Gather resources, craft tools and build whatever you can imagine in a world made of blocks. Survival mode adds monsters and hunger, while Creative mode gives unlimited blocks. Play solo, with friends online or on servers, and split-screen on consoles.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, controller or touch.

title: Minecraft Classic
summary: The original 2009 creative Minecraft, free in the browser. Share a link to build together.
description: The early creative version of Minecraft, released by Mojang for free play in the browser. There is no survival, just 32 kinds of block and a world to build in. Copy the invite link to build with friends. Bugs from 2009 are kept on purpose.

title: Don't Starve Together
summary: Grim, hand-drawn wilderness survival that is much easier with friends.
description: Survive a strange wilderness by gathering food, managing sanity and preparing for winter. Each character has unique abilities, and the game is tough but fair. Play solo or online, where groups can split up tasks.

title: Valheim
summary: Viking survival for up to ten: build longhouses, sail and hunt mythical bosses.
description: Explore a vast Norse afterlife, build a base, craft gear and defeat bosses to progress into more dangerous lands. Building is flexible and satisfying. Up to ten players can share a world online.

title: Deep Rock Galactic
summary: Four-dwarf co-op shooter: mine minerals and fight alien swarms in destructible caves.
description: Space dwarves with distinct classes drill through fully destructible caves to complete mining missions while holding off alien bugs. Teamwork and a strong friendly community make it one of the best four-player co-op games.

title: Left 4 Dead 2
summary: Four-player co-op zombie shooter, plus four-versus-four as the infected.
description: Four survivors fight through hordes of zombies across short campaigns, with an AI director changing enemy placement each time. Versus mode lets four players control special infected against four survivors.

title: Cuphead
summary: Tough run-and-gun boss fights in a hand-drawn 1930s cartoon style.
description: A sequence of demanding boss battles and run-and-gun levels, animated in the style of 1930s cartoons. A second player can join on the same screen for local co-op.

title: Castle Crashers
summary: Four-player co-op brawler with light RPG levelling and a lot of silliness.
description: Four knights hack through a cartoon kingdom, levelling up, collecting animal companions and competing for the princess at the end of each chapter. Play on one screen or online.

title: Helldivers 2
summary: Four-player co-op shooter with friendly fire and orbital strikes.
description: Squads of up to four drop onto alien planets to complete objectives, calling in supplies and airstrikes with directional codes. Friendly fire is always on, which leads to plenty of chaos. Online co-op with cross-play between PC and consoles.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
summary: 2D Mario platformer for up to four, where Wonder Flowers transform every level.
description: Classic side-scrolling Mario with a twist: touching a Wonder Flower changes the level in unexpected ways. Up to four players can play together on one Switch, and some characters take no damage, which helps younger players.
priceNote: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership.

title: Snipperclips – Cut it out, together!
summary: Cut each other into new shapes to solve puzzles. Local co-op for up to four.
description: Two paper characters overlap and snip pieces out of each other to fit shapes, pop balloons or carry objects. It works with one Joy-Con per player, and there are modes for up to four players plus competitive mini-games.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
summary: Huge Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game, solo or with up to four players.
description: A story-driven RPG based on Dungeons & Dragons, with turn-based combat and choices that change how events unfold. Play alone with companions, or with up to four players online; two can play split-screen.

title: Divinity: Original Sin 2
summary: Deep turn-based fantasy RPG with four-player co-op and split-screen.
description: A tactical RPG where fire, water, oil and electricity interact on the battlefield, and each player can pursue their own goals in the story. Supports up to four players online and two in split-screen.

title: Hades
summary: Fast roguelike action: fight your way out of the underworld, one run at a time.
description: As the son of Hades, you battle through randomised chambers of the underworld with gifts from the Olympian gods. Each death sends you home, where the story moves forward, so even failed runs feel like progress.

title: Hades II
summary: The sequel to Hades: a witch princess battles through the underworld and beyond.
description: Play as Melinoë, using magic and new weapons to fight toward the Titan of Time, above and below ground. Keeps the run-based structure of the first game with a new cast and new systems.

title: Hollow Knight
summary: Atmospheric 2D exploration and combat in a vast ruined insect kingdom.
description: Explore the interconnected caverns of Hallownest, find new abilities to reach new areas and face demanding bosses. Hand-drawn, melancholic and full of secrets.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
summary: Sequel to Hollow Knight starring Hornet, climbing through a new kingdom.
description: Play as Hornet, a faster and more acrobatic hero, in a new kingdom full of new enemies, bosses and quests. Keeps the exploration and difficulty the first game is known for.

title: Celeste
summary: Precise platforming up a mountain, with a warm story and generous checkpoints.
description: Help Madeline climb Celeste Mountain through hundreds of tight single-screen challenges. It is demanding, but instant respawns and an assist mode keep it approachable, and the story about anxiety is handled with care.

title: Vampire Survivors
summary: Survive 30 minutes against endless monsters as your weapons fire automatically.
description: You only move; your weapons attack on their own. Level up, combine upgrades and watch the screen fill with effects as thousands of enemies close in. Up to four players can play together on one screen.
priceNote: Free on mobile with optional ads.

title: Balatro
summary: Poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder: bend the rules with joker cards.
description: Play poker hands to beat score targets, then buy jokers and upgrades that break the rules in increasingly wild combinations. Easy to learn if you know poker hands, and very hard to put down.

title: Slay the Spire
summary: The deckbuilding roguelike that defined the genre: build a deck and climb the spire.
description: Climb a randomly generated spire, fighting turn-based card battles and adding cards and relics to your deck along the way. Four characters play very differently, and every run is a new puzzle.

title: Undertale
summary: Quirky RPG where you can talk your way out of every fight.
description: A role-playing game set in a world of monsters, where combat mixes bullet-dodging with the option to spare every enemy. Your choices change how characters treat you and how the story ends.

title: Elden Ring
summary: Challenging open-world fantasy action RPG, with online co-op for tough bosses.
description: Explore the Lands Between on foot or horseback, discovering dungeons, castles and difficult bosses. Summon other players online for help, or face invaders. Freedom to go elsewhere makes the difficulty easier to manage than in earlier FromSoftware games.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds
summary: Hunt giant monsters alone or with a party of four, then craft gear from them.
description: Track and fight huge creatures across changing environments, then use their parts to build better weapons and armour. Hunts can be played solo with AI support or online with up to three others, with cross-play.

title: Genshin Impact
summary: Free open-world action RPG with elemental combat and four-player co-op.
description: Explore a large fantasy world, switching between characters whose elemental attacks combine for extra effects. The story and exploration are solo, and many challenges can be done in online co-op with up to four players.
priceNote: Free to play with optional purchases, including random character draws.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, controller or touch.

title: Fortnite
summary: Free-to-play battle royale with building, plus thousands of player-made modes.
description: Drop onto an island with up to a hundred players and be the last player or squad standing. Beyond battle royale, Fortnite hosts many other modes, from LEGO survival to player-made games. Squad up with friends online, with cross-play everywhere.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, controller or touch.

title: Valorant
summary: Five-versus-five tactical shooter with character abilities.
description: Two teams of five take turns attacking and defending bomb sites. Precise aim matters, but every agent also has abilities for scouting, blocking sight lines or healing. Queue alone or with a full party of five.
priceNote: Free to play; optional cosmetic purchases.
controls: Keyboard and mouse on PC; controller on consoles.

title: Counter-Strike 2
summary: The free-to-play tactical team shooter: plant or defuse the bomb.
description: Terrorists and counter-terrorists play rounds of bomb plants and defusals, buying weapons with money earned from previous rounds. Squad up with up to four friends for five-versus-five matches.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Dota 2
summary: Free five-versus-five MOBA with over a hundred heroes and deep strategy.
description: Two teams of five heroes battle to destroy each other's Ancient, farming gold and experience along three lanes. Every hero is free to play. It has a steep learning curve and a lot of depth.
priceNote: Free to play; optional cosmetic purchases.

title: League of Legends
summary: Free five-versus-five MOBA: pick a champion and take down the enemy Nexus.
description: Two teams of five champions push lanes, take objectives and try to destroy the enemy base. Matches take around half an hour, and there are quicker modes such as ARAM. Play with up to four friends in a party.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Apex Legends
summary: Free-to-play squad battle royale built around hero abilities and fast movement.
description: Squads of three drop into a shrinking arena, loot weapons and fight to be the last team alive. Each legend has abilities that support the squad, and a ping system makes it easy to cooperate without voice chat.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Agar.io
summary: The original .io game: eat smaller cells, avoid bigger ones and grow.
description: Control a cell in a crowded petri dish. Eat pellets and smaller players to grow, split to chase prey, and avoid anyone bigger than you. Party mode lets you create a private game with a code for friends.
priceNote: Free with ads and optional purchases.
controls: Mouse to move, Space to split, W to eject mass.

title: Krunker.io
summary: Fast pixelated first-person shooter that runs in the browser.
description: Quick arena FPS matches with classes, fast movement and slide-hopping, all running in a browser tab. Join a public match in seconds or host a custom game for friends.
priceNote: Free with ads and optional purchases.

title: Shell Shockers
summary: Browser shooter where the players are armed eggs.
description: Cartoon eggs with guns battle in quick arena matches. It runs in the browser, needs no account and supports private games you can share with friends.
priceNote: Free with ads and optional purchases.

title: bonk.io
summary: Physics party game: bump other balls off the map in quick rounds.
description: Players control bouncing balls and try to knock each other off the level using momentum and a heavy mode. Create a room and share it with friends, or join a public game. Includes a map editor.
controls: Arrow keys; X for heavy mode.

title: Lichess
summary: Free, ad-free, open-source chess. Play the computer or a friend, no account needed.
description: Play chess against the computer, online opponents or a friend you send a link to. Lichess is run as a non-profit, has no ads and is open source. Puzzles, lessons and analysis tools are all free, and you don't need an account to play.
priceNote: Free with no ads; funded by donations.
controls: Mouse or touch; keyboard move entry available.

title: Tabletop Simulator
summary: A virtual table for playing almost any board or card game with friends online.
description: A physics sandbox with dice, cards, boards and pieces. Play classic games that come included, or thousands of community-made games from the Workshop. Rules aren't enforced, just like a real table, so you can also flip it.

title: Hearthstone
summary: Free collectible card game with quick one-on-one matches and a solo Battlegrounds mode.
description: Build decks from Warcraft-themed cards and battle other players one-on-one, or play Battlegrounds, an auto-battler mode. There is also single-player content against the computer.
priceNote: Free to play; optional card pack purchases.

title: Marvel Snap
summary: Fast Marvel card battles that take about three minutes each.
description: A one-on-one card game across three locations, played over six turns. Both players act at the same time, and 'snapping' raises the stakes when you think you're winning. Games are short enough for a quick break.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.
accountNote: Needs an account (store or Marvel Snap).

title: Wingspan
summary: Digital version of the bird-collecting board game for one to five players.
description: Attract birds to your wildlife preserves and build engines of card combos. The digital version handles all the rules and scoring, with pass-and-play on one device, online games and a solo mode.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
summary: Remastered classic real-time strategy: build an empire and conquer rivals.
description: Gather resources, build a town and advance through the ages while commanding armies of dozens of civilisations. Includes long campaigns, skirmishes against the AI and online matches for up to eight players.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
summary: Turn-based strategy: guide a civilisation from the stone age to the space age.
description: Found cities, research technologies, build wonders and win through science, culture, religion or conquest. Play alone against AI leaders, online with friends, or in hotseat mode on one computer.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; controller or touch on other platforms.

title: Into the Breach
summary: Compact turn-based tactics where you see every enemy move before it happens.
description: Command three mechs defending cities from giant monsters on small eight-by-eight grids. Enemies show what they're about to do, so each turn is a puzzle about pushing, blocking and redirecting attacks.

title: Mini Metro
summary: Minimalist puzzle about designing a subway map for a growing city.
description: Draw lines between stations as a city grows, managing limited trains and tunnels until the network overloads. Clean, calm and surprisingly tense near the end of a game.

title: Clash Royale
summary: Quick real-time card battles on mobile: take down your opponent's towers.
description: Deploy troops and spells from a deck of eight cards to destroy the enemy's towers in three-minute matches. Play one-on-one or two-versus-two with a friend.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Brawl Stars
summary: Fast three-versus-three mobile battles with a large cast of brawlers.
description: Short team matches in many modes, from gem collecting to soccer to battle royale. Team up with friends for three-versus-three matches or duo showdowns.
priceNote: Free to play; optional purchases.

title: Wordle
summary: One five-letter word a day, six guesses. Free in the browser.
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries. After each guess, coloured tiles show which letters are in the word and in the right place. There is one puzzle a day, so it takes a few minutes. Created by Josh Wardle and now published by The New York Times.

summary: Slide numbered tiles and merge them to reach 2048.
description: Every move slides all tiles in one direction, and matching numbers merge into their sum. Plan ahead to keep your biggest tiles in a corner and avoid filling the board. Free in the browser by its original creator.

title: Little Alchemy 2
summary: Combine elements to discover hundreds of new ones, starting from air, earth, fire and water.
description: Drag two elements together to see what they make: fire and water make steam, and it grows from there to hundreds of items. Relaxed, logical and good for all ages.

title: A Dark Room
summary: A text-based browser game that starts with lighting a fire and keeps growing.
description: It begins with a single button to stoke a fire. Slowly a village, a world map and a story appear. A minimalist mix of idle game and text adventure that is best discovered without spoilers.
priceNote: Free in the browser; paid mobile apps.

title: Cookie Clicker
summary: The classic idle game: click a cookie, buy grandmas, bake billions.
description: Click to bake cookies, spend them on upgrades that bake for you, and watch the numbers climb absurdly high. Free in the browser, with paid versions on Steam and mobile.
priceNote: Free in the browser; paid on Steam.

title: Universal Paperclips
summary: An incremental game about an AI that makes paperclips. It escalates.
description: You play an artificial intelligence whose job is to make paperclips. Start by pricing clips and buying wire; it becomes something much bigger. Free in the browser and completable in an afternoon or two.
priceNote: Free in the browser; paid mobile app.

title: TETR.IO
summary: Free modern stacker in the browser, with solo modes and competitive multiplayer.
description: A fast, customisable falling-block game with solo modes such as 40 lines and blitz, plus online versus rooms where clearing lines sends garbage to opponents. Create a custom room to play with friends.
priceNote: Free; optional supporter subscription.
accountNote: Can be played as a guest; ranked play needs a free account.

title: Line Rider
summary: Draw a track and watch a sledder ride it. A toy more than a game.
description: Draw lines with the pencil, press play and watch the rider sled along them under simple physics. Build jumps and loops, or spend hours making an elaborate track timed to music.

title: QWOP
summary: Run a 100-metre race by controlling each leg muscle with Q, W, O and P.
description: An athletics game where four keys control an athlete's thighs and calves. Getting even a few metres is an achievement, and the flailing is half the fun. Famous, frustrating and free in the browser.

title: Crossy Road
summary: Endless hopping across roads, rivers and train tracks. Just keep going.
description: Tap to hop forward across traffic, rivers and railways for as long as you can. Collect coins to unlock hundreds of blocky characters, many with their own worlds.
priceNote: Free with ads and optional purchases.

title: Baba Is You
summary: Puzzle game where you change the rules by pushing words around.
description: The rules of each level are written as blocks, like BABA IS YOU or WALL IS STOP. Push the words into new sentences to change how the level works. Brilliantly clever and often very hard.

title: Tetris Effect: Connected
summary: Tetris set to music and light, with co-op and versus multiplayer.
description: Classic Tetris wrapped in music and visuals that react to every move. Connected mode lets three players team up against a boss, and there are local and online versus modes.
controls: Controller or keyboard; VR supported on PC.

title: The Witness
summary: Explore a quiet island full of line puzzles that teach themselves without words.
description: Hundreds of line-drawing puzzles are spread across a colourful island. There are no instructions: each area teaches its own rules through sequences of puzzles, and the island itself hides secrets.

title: Spelunky 2
summary: Roguelike cave-diving platformer, playable in four-player co-op or versus.
description: Descend through randomly generated caves full of traps, creatures and secrets, where every run starts from scratch. Up to four players can explore together on one screen or online, or fight in the arena mode.

title: Rayman Legends
summary: Joyful 2D platformer for up to four players on one screen, with music levels.
description: Run, jump and punch through colourful hand-painted worlds with up to three friends on the same screen. The rhythm levels, where every jump lands on the beat of a song, are a highlight.
accountNote: Needs a store account and a Ubisoft account.

title: PowerWash Simulator
summary: Relaxing simulator about pressure-washing dirty things until they're spotless.
description: Clean vehicles, houses and playgrounds with a pressure washer until every patch of dirt is gone. It is calm and satisfying, and up to six players can clean together online.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
summary: Drive a lorry across Europe, deliver cargo and build a haulage company.
description: Take jobs delivering cargo across a large map of Europe, follow the road rules, and grow your own trucking business. Surprisingly relaxing. Convoy mode lets up to eight friends drive together.

title: Cities: Skylines
summary: City builder: zone districts, route traffic and manage a growing city.
description: Lay out roads, zone neighbourhoods and provide water, power and services as your city grows. Traffic management is its own puzzle. A large mod community adds almost anything you can imagine.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; controller on consoles.

title: The Sims 4
summary: Life simulation: create people, build homes and shape their lives. Free base game.
description: Create Sims, build and furnish their homes, and guide their careers, relationships and daily lives. The base game is free; expansion packs add more to do.
priceNote: Base game is free; expansion packs are paid.
controls: Keyboard and mouse; controller on consoles.

title: Golf With Your Friends
summary: Mini golf for up to twelve players, with power-ups and ridiculous courses.
description: Everyone plays each hole at the same time, so there is no waiting. Courses range from simple to absurd, and optional power-ups add chaos. Play online with up to twelve players.

title: Nintendo Switch Sports
summary: Motion-controlled sports for up to four: tennis, bowling, badminton and more.
description: Swing Joy-Con controllers to play tennis, bowling, badminton, volleyball, football and chambara swordplay. Easy to pick up for any age, and good for a room full of people taking turns.
priceNote: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership.

title: Bloons TD 6
summary: Monkey-powered tower defense with deep upgrades and four-player co-op.
description: Place monkey towers along the track to pop waves of balloons, choosing between upgrade paths for each tower. Heroes, dozens of maps and online co-op for up to four players keep it going for a long time.

title: Kingdom Rush
summary: Classic fantasy tower defense with barracks, mages, archers and artillery.
description: Build and upgrade four tower types along the road to stop orcs, trolls and worse, calling in reinforcements and rain of fire when things get tight. A well-loved classic of the genre.

title: Plants vs. Zombies
summary: Defend your lawn from zombies by planting peashooters, sunflowers and more.
description: Plant a garden of defensive plants in rows across your lawn to stop waves of zombies. Sunflowers produce the sun you spend on everything else. Charming, easy to learn and good for all ages.

title: Mindustry
summary: Open-source factory-building tower defense with online co-op and PvP.
description: Build conveyor belts, drills and factories to feed ammunition into your turrets while waves of enemy units attack. It combines factory automation with tower defense and real-time strategy. It is open source, and free on itch.io.
priceNote: Pay what you want on itch.io; paid on Steam.

title: Raft
summary: Survive on a tiny raft at sea and grow it into a floating base, with up to eight friends.
description: You start on a few planks in the ocean, hooking debris to expand your raft, craft tools and fend off a shark. Later you sail to islands and follow a story. Up to eight players can share a raft.

title: Subnautica
summary: Underwater survival and exploration on an alien ocean planet.
description: Crash-land on an ocean world, then scavenge, craft and build bases as you dive deeper into beautiful and sometimes terrifying waters. The story unfolds through what you find.

title: Grounded
summary: Shrunk to the size of an ant, survive a suburban back garden with up to four players.
description: Tiny teenagers must survive a garden full of giant insects, building bases from grass and gathering food and water. Solo or online co-op for up to four.

title: Garry's Mod
summary: Physics sandbox with thousands of community game modes.
description: Spawn objects, weld them together and experiment with physics, or join servers running community-made game modes such as hide-and-seek and murder mysteries. Many modes need content from other Valve games.

title: Townscaper
summary: Click to place blocks and watch them become a charming island town.
description: There are no goals: click on the water to add blocks, and the game shapes them into houses, arches, stairs and gardens. A calm toy for building pretty towns in minutes.

title: A Short Hike
summary: Gentle exploration game about climbing a mountain on an island park.
description: Hike, climb and glide around a small island park on your way to the summit, meeting characters and finding side activities. It takes a couple of hours and is warm and relaxing.

title: Unpacking
summary: A calm puzzle about unpacking boxes, and a life story told through belongings.
description: Unpack a person's possessions into each new home, finding a place for every item. There is no text; you learn who they are through the things they keep across the years.

title: Outer Wilds
summary: Explore a tiny solar system stuck in a 22-minute time loop.
description: Pilot a rickety spaceship around a handmade solar system, uncovering the mystery of an ancient civilisation. Everything resets every 22 minutes, and the only thing you keep is what you've learned.

title: DREDGE
summary: Fishing adventure with something wrong beneath the waves.
description: Captain a small fishing boat around remote islands, sell your catch and upgrade your vessel. By day it's relaxing; after dark the sea gets strange. Inventory packing and a creeping mystery tie it together.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
summary: Open-world adventure across Hyrule's land, sky and depths, with build-anything abilities.
description: Explore a vast Hyrule, from floating sky islands to underground depths, and use abilities that let you fuse objects together to build vehicles, weapons and contraptions. Very open-ended and very long.

title: We Were Here
summary: Free two-player co-op puzzle game: escape a castle talking only by walkie-talkie.
description: Two players are separated in a frozen castle. One sees the clues, the other sees the puzzle, and the only link is a walkie-talkie. Free on Steam and short enough for an evening.
accountNote: Needs a Steam or console account.
